name: Bash
description: Run a shell command in the agent work-dir sandbox.

function.name: bash
function.description: Run a bash command with cwd jailed to the agent's work directory. Returns stdout/stderr text.

background.description: If true, start without waiting and return a process job id.

workplace.description: Optional workplace id/name/host when the agent has multiple (e.g. aio-serv).
